major_work.name: Counterfactual Relative Response Matrix
major_work.problem: Raw price/turnover reactions confound stock-specific demand with market, sector, event and time-of-day effects.
major_work.hypothesis: A matched-control counterfactual residual response can separate stock-specific absorption/continuation from common-factor moves better than raw relative strength or turnover alone.

AI-D: only if data pipeline needs point-in-time peer snapshots; do not block hypothesis work

kill_criteria: no out-of-sample incremental value over raw relative strength
